steps.content: The young scientists' sanctuary has been reduced to rubble. Amid the flames, you and Isomer stand facing each other, both knowing that this moment was always inevitable.
You speak first.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: EDGE-02 has been attacked. The Observation Hub is in complete chaos. At a critical time like this, why aren't you out there leading the team? You're the one in charge now.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Because salvaging the research left behind by those geniuses is more important.
She looks at you, smiling.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Don't blame me for leaving my superior to her fate. EDGE-02's murderer will be the Sillage Society, the Underground's sorcerers—not me.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: She personally ordered the restructuring of the Observation Hub. She wanted the most experienced frontline experts replaced. That was a risk she chose to take. She'll have to face the consequences now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You arranged this experiment. One of EDGE's top three seats was attacked on your watch. You think you can get away with this?

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Accountable? Heh...

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Wasn't she the one who said that every EDGE seat should be replaceable? It's simply the logical conclusion of her own principle. If 07 can be replaced, then so can 02. Who knows? Maybe I'll even end up on the bench myself.
Isomer spreads her arms wide, as though a cage that has long held her captive has finally fallen apart. Her wish is fulfilled at last, and she's finally free from all restraint.
...It's almost absurd.

options: Who exactly are you trying to fool?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The Underground relies on dimensional fissures to launch their attacks. And to create fissures this clean and precise... That couldn't be achieved without someone inside the Hub who could coordinate every move for them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're burying years of ambitious plotting with your own hands.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You've already come this far, burning your bridges along the way... Isomer, what exactly are you after?!

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Oh, come on, Chief. The Isomer you know is supposed to be a power-hungry schemer. She'd stop at nothing to climb higher.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: I've already secured the seventh seat. Now that I have this rare opportunity, I must clear out the positions above as well. Don't get in my way.
She looks at you with those predatory eyes, no longer concealing the blood lust in them.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: If necessary, I can stage another "accident" to get rid of all those who know about the truth.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: I don't value you the way EDGE does. True, the <color=#fb9259>Shepherd</color> is vital to science and our civilization... but I don't share their grand pursuit. And I just so happen to have been in contact with the Underground.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: I know you're not the <color=#fb9259>sole</color> bearer of the shackles, ${PlayerName}. Be careful. Stand in my way, and this time, you really will die.
Damn it! She knows Schorl is offline too? That means she's going to...
You instinctively release your power. At the same moment, Isomer raises her hand, and a fissure tears open at your waist.
A gaping maw clamps down around you. The shackles you just released strain desperately against it, barely keeping you from being sliced in half.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: Middle-Aged Spectator
Schorl rushes over, too eager to save you that it ignores its surroundings. A fissure tears open in its path, and the bipyramid dives straight in and vanishes.
You fight desperately for that sliver of room keeping you alive with your shackles, unable to struggle free. You look toward Isomer...

She surveys the space with an authoritative air, the cube in her hand vibrating with surging energy. The constantly fluctuating Mania field and the shockwaves pulsing in from every direction indicate that fissures are opening up constantly, ushering Underground Puppets in. This isn't the power of a Sinner.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You... you're using that cube... to communicate with the Underground.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're sending the Sages the coordinates for the attacks! You're helping them seize the Black Ring, aren't you?!
She laughs.
Just as before, she's simply made a deal with someone. Even if that "someone" has changed from Chief to the Underground, the nature of it doesn't change.

Isomer looks away from ${PlayerName} and moves past him. An extremely wide Mania fissure slowly gapes open a dozen meters ahead, ripping through the layers of defenses on the other side of the passage.
steps.female_content: Isomer looks away from ${PlayerName} and moves past her. An extremely wide Mania fissure slowly gapes open a dozen meters ahead, ripping through the layers of defenses on the other side of the passage.

steps.content: On the other side, that woman is right ahead. How long has it been? At last, they meet again. Through the chaotic distortion of the fissure, Isomer sees that detestable figure she'll never forget. She continues to step forward.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Power is such a marvelous thing. One needs no reason to pursue it.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Once you've tasted power, everything else pales in comparison. Talent, ideals... Nothing matters anymore. Climb to the top, and you alone get to define the value of all things.
[Flashback] [N10-6], Night

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Of course, I can give you the position you desire. I can also give you the truth you seek.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Those kids... Do you want to know how many secrets they've hidden in the treasures in their little hideaway? Do you want to know... what those little geniuses will face once it all comes to light?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Go ahead and picture it, Isomer. This is your first step toward the future.
[Exit Flashback]
The ashes of the toys are ruthlessly crushed by each footstep. Those cherished items have crumbled into powder, merging with the Mania filling the space.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: It makes you think you can do whatever you want. Trample over human lives. Brag about your twisted, cruel "hobby" shamelessly.

steps.speaker: Abhorrent Memory
steps.content: This batch of samples is indeed quite charming and representative.

steps.speaker: Abhorrent Memory
steps.content: Pure, and therefore efficient. Proud, and therefore easy to satisfy. Young, and therefore replaceable. Their ambitions are so persistent, so transparent, so predictable. That's what makes their hearts such handy tools.

steps.speaker: Abhorrent Memory
steps.content: Look, they're even obsessed with their adorable little idol.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: Put a despicable, hollow, ugly soul in a position of power, and people will turn it into an object of worship. How laughable.

steps.speaker: Abhorrent Memory
steps.content: 372 has been selected as a candidate for EDGE-07. She is quite pleased. She seems to look up to me and 01. Hmm... I see. In the field of human consciousness studies, I am indeed a leading figure. I suppose I could be considered... <color=#fb9259>a rare talent</color>.

steps.speaker: Abhorrent Memory
steps.content: What do you think, Director Isomer? You're always the first to spot a genius. Let's have a chat, shall we?

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: And after everything, you want me to be your accomplice?

She steps into the fissure. Mania tears at her consciousness, yet it also allows her to clearly perceive the overlapping eigenspaces. She sees that woman's face with perfect clarity. EDGE-02 lifts her head slightly and looks back at her.
Then she smiles, just as she did back then.

steps.speaker: EDGE-02
steps.content: Tell me, Director... What do you think of me as a <color=#fb9259>scientist</color>?

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: ...Don't make me laugh! You've never sought the light of truth, nor have you ever seen it.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: You want to know what I'll do with this power? Simple. Something I couldn't do before.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: To purge the poison from the system. To correct the mistakes. To liberate the potential of science and humanity.

steps.speaker: Isomer
steps.content: I clawed my way to the top for one reason—to take down people like you!
[Major CG - 02's Contempt]

steps.speaker: EDGE-02
steps.content: What a shame. You were so close to passing the test, yet you chose to be disqualified.

steps.speaker: Flawed Schorl
steps.content: All Ring Weapons in the data center have been contaminated! The coordinates and firewall data have been leaked! The Underground fissures are spreading!!
